title: Appeal

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello LetsCuddle,

Please be aware that players may be uncomfortable with that subject due to the sensitivity of it. You were given multiple verbal warnings by both UnitedPingdom and I; asking you to stop. As well, you received a kick from me due to the jokes you were making about this topic. Because of this, this appeal is denied.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez | Jessica
